He runs his own company, describes himself as making deals all day, provides for his family, and concedes capacity in the act of objecting: 'even if we know we have good salaries here in Denmark... we have a good salary and we have a good lifestyle.' On occupation and money he is squarely the ICP. On starting point he is not. Health is not a neglected corner of a good life — it is a compressed disc, two years of untreated high blood pressure, a knee that subluxes and a hip he cannot move, and he frames the purchase as reversal rather than improvement: 'I think I'm heading downwards in this game at this point. And I will be more and more weak.' At 105 kg targeting 90 kg with essentially no training history, this is a rescue. The pattern that matters across the corpus is visible here in one prospect: he passes every criterion the stated ICP contains and fails the one it does not have, which is whether the body can safely do the work.
